Alger, 19 août 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Alg: Algiers, August 19, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Algérie Télécom reminds that verification codes constitute personal and confidential data. The operator insists on their non-disclosure, even when requested by third parties claiming to be official.
ALGER — Dans un communiqué publié ce jou: ALGIERS — In a press release published today, Algérie Télécom reminded its service users that verification codes sent via SMS or other channels must under no circumstances be communicated to third parties. The operator emphasizes that these codes, used to validate sensitive operations, are strictly personal and confidential.
L'entreprise a insisté sur la nécessité: The company insisted on the necessity of protecting this information, specifying that any sharing exposes users to digital fraud risks. Algérie Télécom also called on customers to report any suspicious attempt or request for a verification code originating from an unidentified source.
Dans son message, Algérie Télécom a rapp: In its message, Algérie Télécom recalled that verification codes are linked to the digital identity of subscribers. Their disclosure, even to interlocutors presenting themselves as representatives of official bodies, is prohibited. The operator emphasized that its services never request this type of information by phone or via unsecured channels.
L'entreprise a également invité les util: The company also invited users to adopt increased vigilance against phishing attempts, often used to extort personal data under false pretenses.
